environment.description: Identical Node.js 18 Express application deployed in ECS Fargate task with ephemeral storage. Task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with tmpfs mount at /tmp (size 64MB, noexec). Application document root /var/app/documents is an EFS access point with IAM-authorized mount enforcing posixUser uid:1000 and rootDirectory path /production/docs (access point creation path). The EFS file system policy denies any client that does not use TLS and denies root access (elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess condition). The Fargate task IAM role has a permissions boundary that denies elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite except to the specific EFS access point ARN with condition aws:ResourceTag/writable=true, and the /production/docs access point is tagged writable=false. pgBouncer sidecar container in same task with transaction pooling mode, prepared_statement_cache_size=0 for compatibility. Network configuration uses awsvpc mode with security group allowing only egress to EFS mount target and RDS on respective ports.

config.network_egress: restricted to EFS mount target SG and RDS SG only
